question: Can a tied two-read Qwen evidence loop improve both generated answers and the answer likelihood on unseen English two-fact deduction stories versus untouched Qwen Base?
protocol: One question per deduplicated entire story. Both arms see identical original English statements and question with thinking enabled, unrestricted greedy vocabulary and 192-token first-turn limit. Freeze 64 separate replication stories before fitting. Score complete visible answers, independent four-animal shared-prefix probe, and actual synchronized end-to-end generation seconds including every evidence pass. The adapter is fit on 240 publisher training stories. Both support edges and final full-vocabulary CE are trained. The first native pass encodes every sentence with Qwen layers 0..15; on the second read, re-enter layers 10..15 on those same first-pass states. Marginalize learned latent fact identity. The ordinary full-context Qwen next-token logits always participate.
gate: Require >=8 net paired generated answers and exact two-sided McNemar p<.05, >=4 net common-prefix probes, <=1.5x Base time. Failure closes downstream work on this checkpoint. A pass licenses an equal-training K1 comparison, then same-weights disabling of the second hop, and disjoint replication. Never select a checkpoint using test outputs. Stop on budget or memory warning.
